subject.title: fix: plugin host commands leave orphan child processes after timeout

question: Should the published `plugin-sdk/run-command` helper expose the same explicit `killProcessTree: false` escape hatch as `PluginRuntime.system.runCommandWithTimeout`, or should process-tree cleanup be an irreversible helper-level policy?
rationale: This changes a public plugin SDK behavior, and current code already exposes an opt-out on the sibling runtime facade; maintainers must choose the permanent cross-plugin contract before a mechanical patch can be considered complete.

options.title: Expose the opt-out
options.body: Add `killProcessTree?: boolean` to the helper options, default it to `true`, and test explicit `false` forwarding.

options.title: Make cleanup mandatory
options.body: Keep the helper hardcoded to tree termination and document that plugin-managed timed commands may not intentionally leave descendants running.

recommendation.title: Expose the opt-out
recommendation.body: Add `killProcessTree?: boolean` to the helper options, default it to `true`, and test explicit `false` forwarding.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a public Plugin SDK contract decision rather than an isolated test or implementation correction.
